university: Asia Pacific University of Technology & Innovation
program_name: Bachelor of Arts (Honours) in Industrial Design

malaysian.diploma_pathway: Diploma in relevant field with CGPA 2.0

requirements.general_text: Direct Entry to Level 1 of the Degree STPM A Pass in STPM with a minimum Grade C (GP 2.00) in any 2 subjects. A Credit in Bahasa Melayu and a Pass in English at SPM level. A-Level 2 Passes (Grade A-D) in A-Level. A Pass in English at SPM/O-Level/IGCSE or its equivalent. UEC 5 Grade B’s in UEC. Matriculation/Foundation A Pass in Matriculation or Foundation studies with a minimum CGPA of 2.00. Additional Requirements Note: Pass an interview OR submission of a Design Portfolio as required. Direct Entry to Level 2 of the Degree Related Diploma A Diploma in Design & Media or equivalent with a minimum CGPA of 2.00. A pass in DKM / DLKM / DVM with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, subject to HEP Senate/Academic Board’s approval. Those with a CGPA of 2.00 need at least two years of working experience. Equivalent qualification and/or experience which is recognised by the Senate/institution. Note: The above entry requirements may differ for specific programmes based on the latest programme standards published by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA). The qualification and entry requirements for the programmes will be determined based on the "Comparison List of Equivalency of International Qualifications with SPM (O-Levels equivalent) and STPM (A-Levels equivalent)" published by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA). International Students IELTS: 5.0 TOEFL IBT: 40 Pearson (PTE): 47 MUET: Band 3.5
